title: Microinsurance Claims Analytics & Fraud Detection
thesis: Snowflake processes microinsurance claims from document parsing (Textract → AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT) through fraud classification (ML.CLASSIFICATION) to automated alerts — enabling 24-hour claims processing for underserved Filipino markets

talking_points: 185,000 claims processed annually — average claim amount ₱12,400.
Current processing time: 18 hours average — within 24-hour IC mandate.
Fraud rate: 2.1% confirmed, but ML flags additional 4.8% as suspicious (₱108M exposure).
tabs.call_out: ₱108M potential fraud exposure — ML flags 4.8% of claims as suspicious

transition.line: Let's see how AI automates processing and catches fraud.

talking_points: AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT extracts data from 520K documents — medical certs, receipts, IDs.
ML.CLASSIFICATION auto-adjudicates 62% of simple claims — no human review needed.
Auto-adjudicated claims: average 4-hour processing time vs 18 hours for manual.
show: Show parsed document example with extracted fields
tabs.call_out: 62% of claims auto-adjudicated — 4 hours vs 18 hours manual

transition.line: Automation handles the volume. ML catches the fraud.

talking_points: ML.CLASSIFICATION trained on 3,800 confirmed fraud cases — identifies 4.8% as suspicious.
Top fraud indicators: same medical certificate number across multiple claims (34%), claim within 7 days of policy purchase (28%).
Geographic hotspot: Mindanao provinces have 3.2x higher fraud rate than NCR.
tabs.call_out: Same medical certificate reused across claims — #1 fraud signal

transition.line: Let the VP ask the system directly.

talking_points: Teresa asks: 'What's our loss ratio for the health microinsurance product?'
Cortex Analyst: 72% loss ratio — above 65% target, driven by Mindanao claims.
Follow-up: 'What does the Insurance Commission require for claims processing time?' — searches IC regulations.
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + regulatory search

talking_points: Textract → AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT → ML.CLASSIFICATION → auto-adjudicate or alert — full pipeline.
Replaces Step Functions + SageMaker + Textract with native Snowflake Task Graphs + ML + AI.
Philippine microinsurance: 55M uninsured. Fast, fair claims processing builds trust.
tabs.call_out: Document to decision in 4 hours — AI-powered claims at scale

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Philippine microinsurance.
